delighted.definition: very pleased or happy about something.
examples: She was delighted to win the prize.

design.definition: to create a plan or drawing for something to be made.
examples: They design computer chips for phones.

designer.definition: a person who creates plans or drawings for something to be made, especially clothing or furniture.
examples: The designer showed their latest collection.

daughter.definition: a female child in relation to her parents.
examples: Her daughter helped bake cookies.
Dessert was delicious.
She was dejected but kept trying.

difficult.definition: not easy to do or understand.
examples: This problem is difficult.

drum.definition: a musical instrument that makes sound when struck with hands or sticks.
examples: The drum is loud in this band.

desk.definition: a piece of furniture with a flat surface for writing or reading.
examples: Her desk is tidy.

dress.definition: a one-piece garment for women or girls; clothing in general.
examples: Her dress is very pretty.

dangerous.definition: able to cause harm or injury; not safe.
examples: The road is dangerous at night.

drama.definition: a play for theater, television, or film; a real-life event that is dramatic.
examples: We watched a dramatic drama.

designing.definition: The act of planning and creating something, especially a plan or drawings.
examples: The designing of the bridge took several years.
The designing of the software started last year.

designing.definition: To plan and create the form, structure, or appearance of something.
examples: She is designing a new app.
They are designing a house.

designing.definition: Describing something that involves planning and creating; used to describe processes or activities related to planning.
examples: The designing phase lasts several months.
We discussed the designing process.

designed.definition: Past tense of the verb meaning to plan and create something.
examples: She designed a new logo for the company.
The building was designed to be energy efficient.

designed.definition: Made or created according to a plan or specification; intended.
examples: The designed brochure looks professional.
The product has a designed-in safety feature.

design-ing.definition: The act of planning and creating something, especially a plan or drawings.
examples: The design-ing of the product took two years.

design-ing.definition: To plan and create the form, structure, or appearance of something.
examples: They are design-ing a new app.

droll.definition: Amusing in a dry or odd way; pleasantly humorous.
examples: His droll comments lightened the mood in the meeting.
The play had a droll sense of humor that eased the tension.

dalmatic.definition: a long ceremonial vestment worn by clergy in some Christian traditions
examples: The bishop wore a dalmatic during the ceremony.

dog.definition: a common pet animal with fur that often barks
examples: Our dog loves walks.
The dog is friendly.

dexterous.definition: good at using your hands or moving skillfully, especially in tasks requiring skill
examples: The surgeon was dexterous.
He is dexterous with tools.

defenestrate.definition: to throw someone or something out of a window
examples: The story says they tried to defenestrate the prisoner.

describe.definition: to explain or give details about something
examples: Can you describe what happened?
She described the house in detail.

dude.definition: a man, often used in informal speech
examples: That dude over there is my cousin.
Hey dude, what’s going on?

dawn.definition: the time of day when the sun starts to rise
examples: We left at dawn.
The sky turned orange at dawn.

dusk.definition: the time in the evening when daylight is ending
examples: We arrived at dusk.
The birds went quiet at dusk.

dope.definition: a drug that is illegal or harmful
examples: The police arrested people for dope.
He was charged after they found dope.

dope.definition: to add drugs to something or to drug someone
examples: They tried to dope the drink.

dope.definition: excellent or exciting in informal speech
examples: That’s a dope idea!
The movie was dope.

dreary.definition: gray, dull, or depressing, making you feel unhappy
examples: The weather was dreary all day.
The office felt dreary.

dingy.definition: dirty or looking dull and not clean
examples: The apartment looked dingy.
The hallway was dingy and quiet.

dawg.definition: informal slang for dog or for a friend, depending on context
examples: My dawg is outside.
That dawg can cook!

doctor.definition: a person who is trained to treat illnesses and injuries
examples: The doctor said it was not serious.
I have an appointment with a doctor.
